events.summary: Tang Wei, in Kanyou with both fifty-man Tang Champion companies under Duan Jin and Shen Rui, advances toward the Qin military authority handling Ouki's requested preliminary command-qualification review while keeping all one hundred private House Tang veterans together and visible as far as lawful Qin protocol permits. He does not claim Qin office or command, and he stops the retinue wherever lawful protocol requires rather than forcing access.
